messages:
sara: Quick sync — building the Console/Observability roadmap for next quarter. Key areas: dashboards (per-model/per-route), tracing hooks (request->model trace), token cost breakdown, and error analytics. Need to prioritize and define launch criteria. Thoughts?

jason: +1. Can we rank by customer impact and engineering effort? My gut: cost breakdown + error analytics = highest ROI, tracing hooks is medium (bigger infra work), dashboards are ongoing.

vimal: Agree. Cost breakdown helps teams prove cost regressions quickly. For tracing hooks, we need runtime and network changes (span context, sampling). That’s ~3-4 sprint lift depending on scope.

lina: From DevEx: dashboards are low lift if we repurpose existing chart components, but we need good defaults and templates for common workflows (latency, token usage, error rates). Customers expect presets.

sara: Customer asks incoming: ACME wants per-route cost split + per-request trace IDs in logs; FinCo asked for error analytics + retention/audit for compliance. So both cost & error analytics have sale motion urgency.

jason: Proposal: Phase 1 (Q1): 1) Token & compute cost breakdown (per-route, per-model, per-user if available), 2) Error analytics (grouping, frequency, link to failing prompts). Phase 2: tracing hooks + open tracing headers. Phase 3: full dashboards + advanced A/B metrics.

vimal: Launch criteria suggestions: cost breakdown must show per-request token + compute estimate, unit tests + sampled traffic verification, <5% perf regression on p99 latency. Error analytics needs grouping heuristics + ability to filter by model/version and timeframe.

sara: Cross-team dependencies: eng-runtime for accurate token/compute metrics, eng-infra for traces/log pipeline, security for retention/KMS checks. Need owners.

jason: I'll own tracing spec (headers, SDK hooks, sampling policy). ETA: draft spec by 1752202000 (next week).

vimal: I'll do infra estimate for traces + long-term storage cost. ETA: 1752202800. Blocking: confirm retention SLA (security).

lina: DevEx will prepare dashboard templates and onboarding copy. Can reuse existing dashboard components. Will provide 2 templates: "Cost Overview" and "Errors & Alerts". ETA: 1752203200.

sara: Launch acceptance checklist (draft):
- Cost: per-route breakdown works end-to-end, accuracy within 5% vs billing, UI + raw CSV export.
- Errors: grouping + root-cause tagging, alerting rule template, replay link to request.
- Traces: sampled traces with span IDs propagated to logs (beta).
- Security: KMS for logs, retention controls, PII filtering doc.
- Perf: no more than +5% p99 on hosted paths.

jason: Note on tracing hooks: suggested header is `x-rw-trace-id`. Example SDK snippet:```js
const traceId = generateTraceId();
fetch('/v1/generate', { headers: { 'x-rw-trace-id': traceId } });
```
We should standardize naming and propagate to KV cache layer.

vimal: Ops note: shipping traces will increase storage costs. Consider sampling at 1% by default, with customer override. Also add TTL + compression.

sara: Prioritization decision (voice vote): cost breakdown + error analytics = P0, tracing hooks = P1, dashboards templates = P1. Anyone opposed?

jason: :thumbsup:

lina: :thumbsup: will start templates.

vimal: :eyes: need security retention confirmation but ok.

sara: Great — action items: Jason -> tracing spec (1752202000). Vimal -> infra + cost estimate (1752202800). Lina -> dashboard templates (1752203200). I'll assemble roadmap doc and PRD after we get traces spec.

ops-bot: deploy-notify: New branch created: `feature/obs-cost-error-q1` by sara at 1752200380.

sara: Thanks team — I'll post the draft PRD in #product once Jason's spec lands. If customers want early access, we can run a private beta for ACME/FinCo. :rocket:
